items.q: How do I export my résumé as a PDF?
items.content: Hit the Download button at the top right of the editor. The same file is what recruiters and ATS systems will see.

items.q: Can I add custom sections that aren't in the template?
items.content: Not currently. However, you can modify existing sections and add additional ones as needed.

items.q: How do I switch between one-column and two-column layouts?
items.content: Open the Layout panel. Toggle Two columns on and choose which sections live in the sidebar. The change is non-destructive — toggle back any time without losing content.

items.q: Can I switch templates without re-typing everything?
items.content: Yes — your content lives separately from the template. Open Templates in the toolbar, hover any template, and click Try this.
Yes. Every template uses standard PDF text (not images), proper section headings, and a single linear reading order under the hood — even the two-column ones.

items.q: How many résumés can I have on the free plan?
items.content: Up to {max} active résumés per account, each with unlimited revisions. There's no premium plan that unlocks more — if you need a fourth, delete one you're not using.

items.q: Where is my data stored, and can I delete it?
items.content: Your résumés are stored on our servers in the EU (Frankfurt). You can delete any individual résumé at any time, or wipe your whole account from Settings → Account → Delete account. Deletion is permanent and immediate — we don't hold soft copies.

items.q: Can I work on my résumé offline?
items.content: Partially. The editor caches your current document so you can keep editing without a connection — changes sync the moment you're back online. Exports require a connection (we render PDFs server-side for consistent fonts).

items.q: Can I export to Word (.docx) or plain text?
items.content: Not yet. We deliberately ship only PDF for now — it's the only format where what you see is exactly what the recruiter gets. Word export is on the roadmap for late 2026.

sections.title: The agreement
sections.body: By creating an account or using Weave CV, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you don't agree, please don't use the service. We tried to keep the legalese to a minimum.

sections.title: What the service is
sections.body:
Weave CV is a web-based résumé builder. You write content, choose a template, and export a PDF. The service is offered free of charge for personal use, with no premium tier.
We reserve the right to limit, suspend, or shut down the service. If we shut it down, we'll give you at least 60 days' notice and a tool to export everything.

sections.title: Your account
sections.body:
You're responsible for keeping your password safe. One person, one account — don't share credentials with others. You must be at least 16 years old to use Weave CV (or the minimum age in your jurisdiction, whichever is higher).
We may suspend accounts that abuse the service — see Acceptable Use below — but we'll always tell you why and give you a way to export your data first.

sections.title: Your content
sections.body:
You own your résumé content. Full stop. We claim no rights over what you create. The only license you grant us is the technical one we need to display, store, and export your content on your behalf.
If you delete a résumé or your account, that license ends immediately and we delete the content.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body:
Don't use Weave CV to:

  Create fraudulent résumés or impersonate someone else.
  Upload illegal content, malware, or anything that infringes someone else's rights.
  Probe, scrape, or attempt to break the service or other users' accounts.
  Resell, sublicense, or repackage Weave CV as your own product.

sections.title: Our intellectual property
sections.body:
The Weave CV name, logo, and brand assets are ours.
Templates are released under CC BY 4.0: free to use and modify, including commercially, with attribution.

sections.title: Service availability
sections.body: We aim for 99.5% uptime but do not guarantee it. The service is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We're a small team running a free product — please plan accordingly and keep local PDF copies of important résumés.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
sections.body:
To the maximum extent permitted by law, Weave CV is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the service — including lost job opportunities, lost data, or lost time.
Under no circumstances will we be liable for any loss, damage, or injury that results from a third-party's use of Weave CV.

sections.title: Termination
sections.body:
You can delete your account any time from Settings → Account → Delete account. Deletion is immediate and irreversible.
We may terminate accounts that violate these terms, with notice unless the violation is severe (e.g. fraud, abuse). On termination, your access ends and your data is deleted within 30 days.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update these terms occasionally. Material changes are emailed to all users at least 30 days before they take effect. If you keep using Weave CV after the change date, you're accepting the new terms.

tldr.v: We don't sell or rent your data — full stop.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body:
This Privacy Policy explains what data Weave CV collects, how we use it, and what choices you have. We wrote it in plain English on purpose — if anything is unclear, email us and we'll rewrite it.
The short version: we only collect what we need to make the product work, we never sell your data, we never train AI models on it, and you can delete everything at any time.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body:
We collect three categories of data:

  Account data — your email address and a hashed password, or a Google/GitHub OAuth identifier if you sign in that way.
  Résumé content — everything you type into the editor (work history, education, skills, contact details).
  Usage data — anonymized page views, error logs, and which template you used. We do not use third-party analytics; this is collected by our own server.

We do not collect: precise location, contacts, browser history, advertising identifiers, or any data from cookies beyond the one session cookie that keeps you logged in.

sections.title: How we use it
sections.body:
Your account data lets you log in. Your résumé content is rendered into the editor and exported as PDFs when you ask for one. Usage data helps us fix bugs and decide what to build next.
We do not use your résumé content to train machine-learning models, share it with partners, sell it to recruiters, or surface it in search.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body:
Under the GDPR (and equivalent laws elsewhere), you have the right to:

  Rectify — edit anything in the editor, any time.
  Delete — wipe individual résumés or your whole account from Settings → Account. Deletion is immediate and permanent.
  Object — opt out of any non-essential processing by emailing us.

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.body: Active résumés are kept until you delete them. Account data is kept until you delete your account.

sections.title: Cookies & tracking
sections.body:
We use exactly one cookie: weave_session, a first-party session token that keeps you signed in. It expires after 30 days of inactivity.
No advertising cookies, no third-party trackers, no fingerprinting, no Google Analytics.
